title: Report a fuel price mismatch
summary: Learn how to report a fuel price mismatch if the price at a service station does not match the price shown on the FuelCheck online tool.
intro:
If the fuel price at a service station does not match the price you see on the FuelCheck online tool, you should let the service station operator know about the price mismatch
